title: A laboratory's test for viable organisms in a sample taken before or after a kill step (a heat treatment, an inactivation, a sterilisation). Slot 0 is the call: 1 viable organisms were recovered, 0 none were recovered under the stated method, medium, incubation and limit of detection. Slot 1 is when the sample was taken: 0 before the kill step, 1 after it. None recovered is not proof that a batch is dead or sterile. Which batch, which strain record, which method, medium, incubation, portion and limit of detection are in the laboratory's signed result statement (veilcore/lab-result/v2), not here. There the limit of detection and any count are plain decimals, and one to three digits, a point and three digits ("1.000", "12.500") are refused: German, French and Spanish write the point between thousands, so a reader there takes them for a thousand or more. The laboratory signs the record. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
